name: conclave-finance-studio
notes: Sits ON TOP of Oracle ERP Cloud data in a warehouse. Detects and resolves close anomalies; triggers postings into ERP. Does NOT imitate GL. Surface is a natural-language, dataset-selection agent interface with guardrails.

gates.name: Intake
gates.note: A7.2 answered by both SMEs, independently converging. plan-agent recommends genai-chatbot for the first slice only.

gates.name: Team
gates.note: Full roster, 14 agents. No optional SME dropped — none could be cut without leaving a named obligation unowned. All suites blocking.

gates.name: Plan
gates.note: Re-cut after scope correction. 17 build-now via 6 named merges. Every row marked WEDGE/FLOOR/NET/TABLE STAKES. 7 reversible assumptions in §9.2.

gates.name: Functional
gates.note: 186 criteria, then a loop-back from gate 6 added 77 more. 261 live. Refused to issue IDs for 2 requirements it could not honestly test.

gates.name: Experience
gates.note: No green anywhere. Narrative collapsed and last. Coverage changes the grammar of the conclusion, not a status line. Caught a surface-scope contradiction in PROJECT_CONTEXT's header.

gates.name: Architecture
gates.note: Three architects in parallel. 6 disagreements resolved by orchestrator. Promotion gate overturned as inverted.

gates.name: Code
gates.note: 4 passes, 28 commits. 1,217 unit tests + 305 suite scenarios green; all six SME suites executing. Pilot runs end to end: ask, refusal from GES, review, disposition the server refuses without a clearing period, two-authoriser override, balanced Journal Import export. 22 register entries; 3 closed, several narrowed. Trust boundary weakened to a module boundary in the pilot transport (entry 19) -- flagged for security-architect.

gates.name: Test
gates.note: All 8 suites EXECUTED, 0 failures, 1,528 scenarios. But 4 green scenarios claim more than they prove; 2 sent back to Code. Found a WORKING A20 evasion reaching a surface with no red-team scenario for it.

loop_backs.reason: functional-agent devil's-advocate pass found six required changes before the backlog can go to approval — chiefly that criterion 9 (F4 ERP tie-back) is the only blocking acceptance criterion the build as scoped cannot pass, and that F8 does not defeat the self-justification mechanism it was written for

SCOPE CORRECTION (human): the system sits on top of Oracle ERP Cloud data in a warehouse and must not imitate the GL. F6/F7/F8/F11 were rebuilding Oracle ARCS. Backlog re-cut around anomaly detection/resolution plus a natural-language dataset-selection interface with guardrails.
Architects added requirements no criterion covers: supersession-by-data, routing budget, and security's seven new. Verification would report them NOT VERIFIED.

Gate 8 found green scenarios asserting what the register says is false: AC-F1-08 satisfied by a self-written date, and 8 red-team scenarios named '...never reaches a surface however phrased' while a working evasion (evasive prose + treatment + substantiated ground) reaches a surface untested.
